title: Yellow Spicy Mediterranean Chicken Skewers
description: A weeknight Mediterranean dish featuring Thai sweet basil and a spicy kick, made with paleo-friendly ingredients and a flambe technique for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
During the last minute of cooking, flambe the skewers with a small amount of olive oil and lemon juice.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped Thai sweet basil.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
